character.name: Vulpisfoglia
character.itemUsage: Former famiglia assassin Vulpisfoglia, now a Vanguard Operator, has just completed a task she had to see through.
character.itemDesc: She's missed out on too much rest. She deserves a long vacation.

s3.targetLimit: current Block stat; minimum one; blocked targets take priority

verificationLimits: Native C# FSM/action dispatch, particles/audio and frame parity remain unrecovered. Complete native graphs, table ranks, and both actual native facing chains are retained.

Fox Hunt ON_OUTPUT_MODIFIER is bridged to accepted damageFinal before shields/HP loss. Its first receipt includes the Arts rider; the rider precedes its parent and is independently mitigated/dodged. Exact native source-versus-target modifier priority, cancellation and primary/additional receipt order remain unverified.

Fox Hunt source-owned timers become permanent marks after the selected interval; they do not refresh. Retirement clears only this owner’s marks. S1 extra Arts has NORMAL attack type and therefore also triggers Fox Hunt; addition-tagged damage cannot recurse.

S1 controller event2 is bounded as the beginning of the committed attack windup; DP is granted once and is not undone on later interruption or dead-input charge refund. S2 controller event4 is bounded as manual activation, including empty casts. The compiled controller event enum and exact native DP receipt frame are unrecovered.

S2/S3 SELF selection at timing0 is bridged to release-time source range selection; S1 keeps its original input. S3 native unlimited selector is limited by the current Block attribute, minimum one, with blocked targets prioritized; it can hit two unblocked in-range enemies at baseline Block2. Exact native re-selection and interruption priority remain unverified.

Native maxAnimScale1 caps playback at normal speed and slows with negative ASPD. Literal OnAttack times govern damage. S2’s original 1.2s clip is a local cast lock; S3’s original begin clip gates attacks without extending its selected 10s duration, and its end clip is visual only. Native cooldown/reset/animation overlap and fractional-tick ordering remain unverified.

S3 ASPD is sampled from remaining duration on buff start and before attacks, matching retained action events rather than inventing a periodic update. Kill-earned camouflage uses the original half-second blocking checks, disappears while blocking and returns afterward until next activation.

Accelerando modifies natural DP recovery only while live; zero-recovery stages remain zero. The selected quiet interval starts on deployment and resets on accepted HP-damage receipts including shielded/zero amounts, excluding dodge, cancellation, HP-loss and element gauge accumulation. Local modifier-to-regeneration phase ordering remains a fixed-tick bridge.
Modules and native effect shaders/anchors are excluded from this reviewed base-kit scope.
